name: B10-0093/2025 (ECR) – Case of Boualem Sansal in Algeria
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Boualem Sansal in Algeria
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for Algeria to release writer Boualem Sansal, who was arrested in November 2024 and whose health is getting worse. It also asks Algeria to free everyone jailed for using their basic rights, drop the charges against them, and stop laws that crush free speech, press and religion. It wants the European Union's diplomatic service to watch the situation and any trial. The text is an opinion and a demand; it does not change any law itself.

- Nothing changes yet; Parliament demands Sansal and other detainees be freed and charges dropped.
- It affects Boualem Sansal, other prisoners of conscience, and religious minorities in Algeria.
- Next, the EU's diplomatic service is asked to monitor abuses and Sansal's possible trial.
